_doc: Debris that drifts past the ship in play mode (docs/CONTENT.md section 11, the Raft loop; scripts/space/drift_debris.gd). All numbers are here. current: the way and speed debris drifts in world px/s (angle in degrees, 0 = east and 90 = south on the screen; the ship's bow is up), with a slow wobble (wobble_deg swing of the direction, speed_wobble swing of the speed as a fraction, wobble_period seconds). spawn: a piece appears just outside the view (`margin` px) on the upstream side, one every `every` seconds (+-`jitter` of it), at most `max_alive` at once, across a lane as wide as the ship plus `lane_margin` px each side (at most `lane_max` px each side of the ship's middle, so a big ship does not thin the stream); `start_alive` pieces are already drifting when play begins; a piece despawns past the downstream edge of the view (+`margin`) or after `max_age` seconds. relax: how fast a piece's speed returns to the current's (per second). pull: an intake draws a piece within its pull radius toward the mouth at `speed` px/s (`ease` = how fast the piece turns to it, per second). bounce: a piece that hits hull keeps `restitution` of its speed along the normal and gets a sideways kick of up to `kick` times that speed. cargo_limit: most units the hold takes before an intake refuses a piece (0 = no limit yet; the hold of CONTENT section 10 comes later). types: id, name, weight (how often it spawns), size (px across, also its hitbox), art (art/debris/<art>.png + .json; a drawn placeholder in `color` when there is none), yield (cargo id -> units on collection), effect (o2: the fraction of air every room gets), roll (a crate: weighted outcomes, each with an item and a count range [min, max]).
